title: Statements & Conclusions
description: Learn to understand statements, draw valid conclusions, distinguish certainty from possibility, and avoid unsupported assumptions.

title: Assumptions
description: Identify hidden, necessary and implicit assumptions underlying statements, arguments and decisions.

title: Arguments
description: Evaluate arguments, distinguish strong reasoning from weak reasoning, and identify relevant and irrelevant support.

title: Cause & Effect
description: Analyze causal relationships, distinguish causes from effects, and avoid confusing correlation with causation.

title: Course of Action
description: Evaluate proposed actions and select practical, relevant and effective responses to stated problems.

title: Decision Making
description: Choose the best alternative by applying rules, priorities, constraints and sound judgment.

title: Logical Puzzles
description: Solve deduction, elimination and everyday logic problems using structured reasoning techniques.
